newsitem.title: USA: Chicago Fed manufacturing index up 1.0 pct in Dec.
newsitem.headline: Chicago Fed manufacturing index up 1.0 pct in Dec.

text.p: The Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago said its Chicago Fed Midwest Manufacturing Index (CFMMI) rose 1.0 percent to 124.4 in December from a revised 123.2 in November.
The jump in the CFMMI represented "the region's best performance in eight months," the Chicago Fed said in a report.
Gains in the "resource" sector, which comprises food, lumber, oil and chemical products, drove the rise in the overall index, the bank said.
The resource component of the CFMMI rose 1.4 percent in December to 111.3.
In other sectors, machinery rose 1.5 percent to 141.0, steel rose 0.6 percent to 130.9 and auto output inched up 0.1 percent to 132.6.
"The Midwest's manufacturing sector continues to perform well relative to the nation, despite the aging of the current expansion," the Chicago Fed said.
